fields.name: Diamond Arrow
fields.notes:
Diamond arrows damage an area of 21 fields centred on the target (2 fields of radius), just like old [[Fireball Rune]] (before update in 2007). Since target will always be within the damage area, you will hit it even when you miss it. [[Blue Electricity Effect]]s {{Ilink|Blue Electricity Effect}} appears on the damage area.

Diamond Arrows are not affected by Bows [[Imbuing|imbued]] with Elemental Damage such as [[Powerful Frost]]. The damage they deal is always [[Physical Damage]].

fields.name: The Devileye
fields.notes: The first Devileye was looted on [[Valoria]], on March 08, 2009. An article from [[Tibianews]], published on October 21, 2007, suggested that The Devileye has similar attack and hit ratio to those of [[Assassin Star]]s (this was incorrect). However, [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005114426/http://www.tibia-stats.com/index.php?akcja=6003&research=distance research] conducted by [[Tibia-Stats]] suggests that an Assassin Star has a 96% hit rate compared to the 71% hit rate of The Devileye (according to its Distance calculator). The Devileye used with [[Infernal Bolt]]s will have 92 attack points which is 28 more than assassin stars, and will have 2 squares of range more. Having said all of that, a [[Royal Crossbow]] will still do '''more overall damage''' than The Devileye.
